info.title: Microsoft Clarity Data Export API
info.description: Download Microsoft Clarity dashboard data programmatically for advanced analysis and system integration. Returns dashboard insights (traffic, engagement, scroll depth, rage clicks, script errors, and more) as JSON over the last 1-3 days, broken down by up to three dimensions. Limits: 10 requests per project per day; response capped at 1,000 rows, no pagination; results in UTC.

get.description: Fetches the Clarity dashboard data structured in JSON format over a specified date range (last 24, 48, or 72 hours) and can break down insights by up to three dimensions. Metrics include Traffic, Engagement Time, Scroll Depth, Popular Pages, Dead/Rage/Error Click Counts, Excessive Scroll, Quickback Click, and Script Error Count.

parameters.name: numOfDays
parameters.description: Number of days for the data export since the API call: 1, 2, or 3 (last 24, 48, or 72 hours respectively).

parameters.name: dimension1
parameters.description: First dimension to break down insights. Possible values: Browser, Device, Country/Region, OS, Source, Medium, Campaign, Channel, URL.

parameters.name: dimension2
parameters.description: Second dimension to break down insights. Same possible values as dimension1.

parameters.name: dimension3
parameters.description: Third dimension to break down insights. Same possible values as dimension1. Maximum of three dimensions per request.

200.description: Dashboard data grouped by metric. Results are in UTC. Limited to 1,000 rows, no pagination.

metricName.description: Metric name, e.g. Traffic, EngagementTime, ScrollDepth.

information.description: Data points for this metric, one per dimension value combination.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing, invalid, or expired token.

403.description: Forbidden — token not authorized for operation.

429.description: TooManyRequests — exceeded daily limit (maximum 10 API requests per project per day).

bearerAuth.description: API access token generated by a Clarity project admin: project Settings -> Data Export -> Generate new API token.
